Annual Conference, 15-18 September
Registration is now open!
This year’s IOA conference will be held at the Scheibler Konig Hotel in London. All
sessions will take place on-site. Extracurricular trips are being planned to points of
interest around the city on 16 and 17 September, and all are invited to the Wharf
Restaurant for an elegant dinner on the last day of the conference. Please note that
owing to hotel-room availability, the maximum number of attendees is 350. Register
now to secure your spot and book your room early. Also, take advantage of a special
registration rate available only through the end of August. Visit the Registration page
for details.
